items.prompt: We've seen that a fraction is improper when the top number is equal to or bigger than the bottom number.  19/5  And we've seen that a mixed number has a whole number part and a fraction written to its right.  3 4/5  Only improper fractions can be rewritten as mixed numbers, because only improper fractions represent one whole unit or more. So this fraction cannot be rewritten as a mixed number, because it is not improper.  4/5
